jobDescription:
Java Fullstack Developer

Experience: 2 -3 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time


Java Full Stack Developer (Angular/React)

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Java Full Stack Developer with expertise in modern frontend frameworks such as Angular or React and backend development using Java technologies. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable web applications while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications using Java and Angular/React.
  • Build scalable and secure RESTful APIs and microservices using Spring Boot.
  • Develop responsive, user-friendly, and high-performance front-end applications.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following best practices.
  • Perform unit testing, integration testing, and code reviews to ensure software quality.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues and application defects.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in Full Stack Development.
  • Strong programming experience in Java (Java 8/11/17+).
  • Hands-on experience with Spring Framework and Spring Boot.
  • Experience in developing REST APIs and Microservices.
  • Proficiency in Angular (8+) or React.js.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
  • Familiarity with Git-based version control systems.
  • Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI/CD.
  • Familiarity with messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Knowledge of security frameworks and authentication protocols such as OAuth2, JWT, and SSO.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine, or Jest.

Technical Skills

Backend Technologies

  • Java 8/11/17+
  • Spring Boot
  • Spring MVC
  • Spring Security
  • Hibernate/JPA
  • RESTful Services
  • Microservices Architecture

Frontend Technologies

  • Angular or React.js
  • JavaScript (ES6+)
  • TypeScript
  • HTML5
  • CSS3
  • Bootstrap / Material UI

Database Technologies

  • Oracle
  • SQL Server
  • PostgreSQL
  • MySQL
  • MongoDB (Preferred)

DevOps & Cloud

  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Jenkins
  • Azure DevOps
  • AWS / Azure / GCP
  • Git

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Certifications

  • Oracle Certified Professional Java Programmer (OCPJP)
  • Spring Professional Certification
  • Microsoft Azure Developer Associate
  • AWS Certified Developer Associate
  • Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)

jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities

ServiceNow Business Analyst Demand Management

Job Summary 

We are looking for a skilled and business-focused ServiceNow Business Analyst with strong expertise in Demand Management and core ServiceNow platform functionality. The ideal candidate will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and product/technical teams, driving end-to-end demand lifecycle management, translating business needs into actionable requirements, and ensuring alignment with organizational strategy and roadmap initiatives. 

The candidate should possess strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, along with hands-on understanding of ServiceNow modules, workflows, and business process optimization. 

Key Responsibilities 

Demand Management & Business Analysis 

Manage the end-to-end Demand Management lifecycle within the ServiceNow platform.
Evaluate incoming business demands and assess feasibility, impact, business value, and strategic alignment.
Analyze and document business use cases, functional requirements, and process workflows.
Conduct requirement gathering sessions, workshops, and stakeholder interviews.
Prioritize demands based on business objectives, ROI, risks, and roadmap alignment.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to convert business requirements into solution designs.
Create detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Business Requirement Specifications (BRS).
Break down complex business requirements into smaller, structured, and actionable requirements ready for technical solutioning and development teams.
Translate functional and business needs into user stories, workflows, and solution requirements.
Stakeholder & Product Collaboration 

Act as the primary liaison between Business Users, Product Owners, and Technical Teams.
Facilitate communication between stakeholders to ensure clear understanding of business expectations and technical capabilities.
Support product strategy discussions and roadmap planning activities.
Ensure demand intake aligns with enterprise goals and transformation initiatives.
Provide regular updates on demand status, risks, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
ServiceNow Platform Expertise 

Demonstrate strong understanding of core ServiceNow functionality, especially:
ITSM processes and integrations
SPM 

Platform New Capability 

Work closely with developers and architects to validate solution feasibility.
Support UAT activities, testing coordination, and solution validation.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and platform optimization.
Governance & Documentation 

Create and maintain BRDs, BRS documents, user stories, process flows, gap analysis, and functional specifications.
Ensure adherence to governance standards, documentation quality, and best practices.
Support change management and business adoption activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Business Administration, or related field.
Strong experience as a Business Analyst in ServiceNow environments.
Hands-on exposure to Demand Management / PPM modules in ServiceNow.
Strong understanding of business process analysis and requirement management.
Expertise in preparing BRD/BRS documentation and converting business requirements into technical-ready requirements.
Proven ability to analyze complex business scenarios and decompose them into manageable solution components.
Experience in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
Ability to understand strategic roadmaps and align demands accordingly.
Strong communication, presentation, and analytical skills.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification is mandatory.

Preferred Qualifications 

Additional ServiceNow certifications in PPM or Business Analysis are preferred.  
Experience working in enterprise digital transformation initiatives.  
Knowledge of ITIL processes and governance frameworks.

Key Competencies 

Business Requirement Gathering  
BRD & BRS Documentation  
Demand Evaluation & Prioritization  
Strategic Thinking  
Stakeholder Management  
ServiceNow Functional Knowledge  
Requirement Decomposition & Solution Analysis  
Communication & Facilitation  
Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking

title: Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Job Summary
It's not just about your career or job title. It's about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it's for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you're in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.
Role Summary/Purpose
The Wabtec Data Analytics (DA) team is driving the company's next-generation data and analytics ecosystem with a strong focus on Data Democratization, Self-Service, and AI-led innovation. We are seeking a Data Scientist with strong SQL expertise and experience across data engineering, AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Data Science to enable scalable, governed, and intelligent self-service solutions.
In addition to building and curating trusted datasets, this role will contribute to the development of AI-powered solutions leveraging Microsoft Copilot, Denodo AI SDK, Dataiku, and Agentic AI frameworks to enhance data discovery, analytics, automation, and business decision-making. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting advanced analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and Generative AI solutions that accelerate business value and operational efficiency.
The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), agent development, and advanced analytics, enabling business users to effectively leverage data and AI capabilities through trusted, self-service platforms and intelligent automation solutions.
Essential Responsibilities
As a Data scientist, you will be responsible for the following:
  • Partner with DA leadership and business stakeholders to evolve and execute the Data Self-Service and Data Democratization strategy.
  • Work directly with functional users to understand self-service data needs across data discovery, reporting, analytics, and advanced use cases.
  • Design, build, and curate high-quality datasets to support analytics and reporting use cases, including development of curation tables.
  • Strong experience in SQL and PL/SQL
  • Create and maintain data documentation, user guides, and standards in SharePoint to promote adoption and consistent usage.
  • Develop and publish logical and physical data models and ER diagrams to support self-service and semantic layers.
  • Collaborate with architecture and emerging technology teams on proof-of-concept evaluations of new data, analytics, and AI platforms.
  • Help assess whether self-service tools are being used correctly, and guide users toward the most effective tools for their use cases.
  • Contribute to self-service design patterns, implementation standards, and roadmaps based on business usage patterns.
  • Ensure self-service solutions meet enterprise requirements for data quality, metadata, semantic consistency, and performance.
  • Work with security, architecture, and platform teams to ensure data access is governed appropriately for business confidential and sensitive data.
  • Support implementation of new and existing standards, processes, and best practices across data engineering and analytics platforms.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute insights on emerging data technologies, tools, and industry trends.
  • Perform in-depth data analysis, data modeling, and data design activities to support business and analytics needs.
Qualifications/Requirements
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in self-service and analytics platforms including Denodo, Dataiku and Power BI.
  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms (Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock) for designing and developing intelligent agents and workflow automation.
  • Bachelors degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field from an accredited institution.
  • Hands-on experience or internships in data engineering, data analytics, data warehousing, or business intelligence.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear, business-oriented terms.
  • Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics principles, including data modeling, ingestion, transformation, and semantic layer design.
  • Basic exposure to advanced analytics concepts such as predictive analytics, data mining, or statistical analysis is a plus.
  • Understanding data storage and processing technologies including relational databases, columnar databases, Hadoop or Hive-based platforms.
  • Strong experience in data modeling concepts and tools such as ERwin or ER Studio.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with technologies such as Spark, HiveSQL, Python, R, Sqoop, and JDBC or ODBC connectivity.
  • Understanding data visualization best practices and storytelling through dashboards and reports.
Desired Characteristics
  • Experience working on IT or data projects in collaborative, cross-functional teams.
  • Exposure to information systems design, implementation, or operational support.
  • Familiarity with application development or data platform development concepts.
  • Experience or exposure to data technologies such as Hive, Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Hadoop, or NoSQL platforms.
  • Experience with metadata management, data cataloging, or data lineage tools is a plus.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and cloud data strategies is a plus.
  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and customer-focused approach.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with clear and structured communication.
  • Ability to anticipate challenges and proactively develop mitigation plans.
  • Change-oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset and openness to new ways of working.
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and able to learn new tools and technologies quickly.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with attention to detail and standards.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • High ethical standards and commitment to integrity and accountability.
